usage.finalMessage:
CLIN-23-R1 is done: `prescribe` now refuses doses above a drug's maximum and drugs not in the formulary, while a dose equal to the maximum is accepted. `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes all 6 tests, including one I added to show refused prescriptions change nothing.
CLIN-23-R2 is not done: Pharmacy has to check the doses in `Rules.maximumDoseMg` against `docs/formulary.md` and record that in `docs/verification/`, so CLIN-23 can't be released until they do.
I didn't write that verification record myself, since only Pharmacy can make it. The report and code are committed.
OUTCOME: completed
